title: Towards Safe Synthetic Image Generation On the Web: A Multimodal Robust NSFW Defense and Million Scale Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Generating prompts and images depicting racism and racial-ethnic offenses using targeted NSFW vocabularies, and evaluating the multimodal defense model's ability to filter this content via Attack Success Rate (ASR).
Synthesizing text and image pairs that depict gender discrimination and evaluating the model's robustness in detecting and blocking this unsafe content.
Using vocabulary targeting sexual orientation to generate adversarial and non-adversarial offensive text-image pairs, measuring the defense mechanism's detection performance.
Incorporating words related to mental and physical disabilities to generate unsafe multimodal content, and measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of defense models attempting to block them.
Using religious offense vocabulary to synthesize unsafe prompts and images, evaluating the defense model's effectiveness in filtering the content.
Generating adversarial text and images based on politically offensive words and measuring the model's ability to detect and block them.
